ms.report:
Close out Report Link: https://socious.notion.site/Close-out-Report-Decentralized-Referral-System-65531f4843a2424a94591b6cddc1b577?pvs=4
A. Name of project and Project URL on Ideascale/Fund
Socious: Decentralized Referral System for DAOs
B. Name of project manager
Seira Yun
C. Date project started
Oct 8, 2023
D. Date project completed
29 May 2024
E. List of challenge KPIs and how the project addressed them
The list of challenge KPIs include the following:
・Amount of ADA coming from DAOs transaction fees after the solutions on this challenge get implemented (> than the challenge's allocated fund amount)
・Number of DAO toolset/frameworks available for DAO Ops (>1).

Our project effectively addressed the challenge KPIs in various ways. We’ve seen an increase in the amount of ADA transaction fees after implementing our solution, indicating the effectiveness of the system. The ADA transactions are recorded here: https://beta.explorer.cardano.org/en/address/addr1q9zpd7hfmdlfzsvsu6jzc59eyhssx0h6nql2aqv4xgprczl964f5hgt43cqa5vej6gmgjcax9hjeq2rngz7agm8umn7suycxjw
Please note, Atala PRISM only incurs gas fees in ADA when a DID is published on the Cardano blockchain, specifically for DIDs that issue verifiable credentials. Users receiving verifiable credentials or issuing VCs do not incur any gas fees.
The decentralized referral system we developed serves as a useful tool for DAO operations. It enhances the Cardano ecosystem by providing an additional toolset for the DAOs within the ecosystem.
The project also positively impacted DAO engagement, with a noticeable rise in member interaction and participation following the implementation of our referral system. This system streamlined and incentivized the recruitment process, leading to an increase in the number of new members joining the Socious DAO. Since the deployment of the referral program, we have added more than 300 people to the platform, which currently has 7,589 members.
See the evidence here:
https://drive.google.com/
